> .test-b leaks in!

This is just how `extend` works currently. It _is_ questionabe if `.test-b` should appear in the output (i.e. ideally it may not output however there's also no reason why it must not), but the whole snippet looks more like "trying to use `(reference)` as a hack to achieve #1177".
I think its a bug, but would need to work out what's causing it to be sure.

Ah., sorry, my bad. I did miss that with the one level `@import` it actually supresses the output of the extended class (I was under impression that I have tried this as #1177 workaround before and it did not work... But aparently my test was somewhat wrong :)

issue.title: Mixin included in a class / referenced file outputs CSS regardless
(reference) imports broken
Parent selectors not working within mixins using (reference)
When using an @import (reference), mixins that contain an & selector get added to the compiled output improperly
Better explain import by reference with html tag based rules.
